tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Filled buttons, active switches and sliders, progress. Material 3 role; with dynamic colour on, chrome roles come from the wallpaper and these are the fallback scheme.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Extended FAB (Start drive), selected Quick Settings tile, setup step icon wells.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-container.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Tonal buttons and the End drive FAB: present but quieter than primary.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary-container.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Screen background, drawn edge to edge behind the system bars.

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: Setup step cards, list groups.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Widget background fallback, notification preview ground.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Inactive Quick Settings tile, inactive switch track, slider inactive track.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text and the GPS speed readout.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text: units, road source, supporting text, inactive icons.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Outlined buttons, inactive switch border. 3:1 against surface.

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Dividers in lists. Decorative only.

tokens.name: sign-face
tokens.usage: Speed sign disc. Fixed in every theme and never taken from dynamic colour.

tokens.name: sign-ring
tokens.usage: Speed sign ring. Reserved for the sign; never error, badge or button colour. Approximation; check against the NZTA Traffic Control Devices specification.

tokens.name: sign-ink
tokens.usage: Numerals on sign-face.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Over-limit container behind the readout. Fixed, never dynamic. Always with on-caution.

tokens.name: on-caution
tokens.usage: Text on caution.

tokens.name: caution-ink
tokens.usage: Caution as text or icon on surfaces: ‘+8 over’, stale data, denied permissions.

tokens.name: unknown
tokens.usage: Sign ring and numerals when the limit is unknown.

styles.name: sign-numeral
styles.usage: Inside the sign only. Roboto Flex, weight 700, width 80 (condensed) so three digits fit. 42% of the sign diameter; 34% for 100+. Fixed size: scales with the sign, not font scale.

styles.name: speed-readout
styles.usage: Measured GPS speed. Roboto Flex weight 900, width 112 (wide), tabular figures, so measured speed never looks like a sign. Bundled, not system, so it looks the same on every manufacturer’s phone.

styles.name: title-large
styles.usage: Top app bar title, road name.

styles.name: body-large
styles.sample: Limits come from the NZTA National Speed Limit Register.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Supporting text in list items and cards.

styles.name: label-medium
styles.usage: Units, widget captions, tile secondary text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Numeral to unit. All values are dp.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label; gaps between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between cards in a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen margin on compact width; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sign and readout; screen margin on medium width.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: corner-small
tokens.usage: Over-limit container in compact surfaces (widget, tile).

tokens.name: corner-medium
tokens.usage: Snackbars, menus.

tokens.name: corner-large
tokens.usage: Cards, setup steps, Extended FAB.

tokens.name: corner-extra-large
tokens.usage: Over-limit container on the main screen, bottom sheets, dialogs.

tokens.name: corner-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, switches, slider handles, chips: Material 3 buttons are fully rounded.
